the coordination mechanism that is best in terms of overall system performance is the combination of a task oriented instrument with a control oriented instrument.
the coordination of a supply chain can be achieved by using both a task oriented instrument and a control oriented instrument.

the following three coordination instruments are needed for the supply chain to achieve a high level of coordination: (i) the producer should use the task oriented instrument, (ii) the producer should disclose his information about the production costs and (iii) the supplier should disclose his information to the producer about his production costs.
